steps: Install the free Survey Spin app (iOS/Android) and create an account.
Complete every profile box and turn on device location and notifications to maximize matches.
Take surveys as they appear ($1 guaranteed on the first survey); answer the daily poll and do check-ins.
Open the Cashouts tab, choose PayPal (or bank direct deposit / gift card), enter your email, and cash out — most payouts are instant.
timing: Most cashouts instant; up to 3 business days for security review.
what_gets_accepted: Completed surveys; partial credit for disqualifications on some surveys.
when_cash_arrives: PayPal/bank/gift card, usually instant at $5 cashout; up to 3 business days if flagged for security review.
who_pays: Brands and research buyers fund surveys through Social Loop LLC; payouts issued to PayPal, bank, or gift cards.
who_qualifies: US adults with a smartphone whose real profile (location, demographics, habits) matches survey targeting — location-verified check-ins add a real-human moat.
work_available: Survey availability fluctuates ('constantly fluctuating' per FAQ); afternoons/evenings weekdays are the best times.
